sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是档案档案频道的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: The morning of Tuesday, September 1, 2015, started out like any other for Lieutenant
sentences.zh: 2015年9月1日，星期二的早晨，对中尉查尔斯·约瑟夫·格利诺维茨而言，
zh_words: 查尔斯·约瑟夫·格利诺维茨

sentences.en: Charles Joseph Glinowicz.
sentences.zh: 开始得和往常没有任何区别。

sentences.en: The 52-year-old, who went by Joe, climbed into his squad car and began making his way towards the Fox Lake Community Centre in northern Illinois.
sentences.zh: 这位现年52岁、大家都叫他乔的警官坐进巡逻车，开始驶向伊利诺伊州北部的福克斯湖社区中心。

sentences.en: Joe had important business to attend to.
sentences.zh: 乔有重要的事情要处理。

sentences.en: He ran a program called the Fox Lake Explorers, which was a collaboration between the Boy Scouts of America and the Fox Lake Police Department.
sentences.zh: 他负责管理一个名为福克斯湖探险者的项目，这是美国童子军与福克斯湖警察局合作的一个项目。

sentences.en: Geared towards 14- to 21-year-olds, the Explorers gave youths who had an interest in law enforcement hands-on experience with the different aspects of policing.
sentences.zh: 探险者项目主要面向14到21岁的青少年，为对执法工作感兴趣的年轻人提供亲身体验警务各个方面的机会。

sentences.en: The young men and women who trained under Joe's guidance were educated on everything from traffic stops to safe firearm use to crime scene investigation.
sentences.zh: 在乔的指导下接受训练的年轻男女们，从交通拦截到安全使用枪支再到犯罪现场勘查，无所不学。

sentences.en: And who better to teach them than Joe Glinowicz?
sentences.zh: 还有谁比乔·格利诺维茨更适合教他们呢？

sentences.en: A 30-year veteran of the force, Joe had dedicated his entire life to law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 作为警队的30年老兵，乔将自己的一生都奉献给了执法事业。

sentences.en: After leaving high school, he spent four years in the United States Army before rising through the ranks within the Fox Lake Police Department.
sentences.zh: 高中毕业后，他在美国陆军服役四年，随后在福克斯湖警察局一路晋升。

sentences.en: He took on every role available, from canine officer to member of the SWAT team.
sentences.zh: 他承担了所有可担任的职务，从警犬训导员到特警队成员。

sentences.en: He continued to serve in the Army Reserves, amassing a long list of military and department medals.
sentences.zh: 他继续在陆军预备役服役，获得了长长的一串军事和部门勋章。

sentences.en: But for all his achievements, Joe's biggest source of pride was his work with the Explorers.
sentences.zh: 但在他所有的成就中，乔最大的骄傲是他与探险者项目的工作。

sentences.en: Within a year of taking over the post in 1987, Joe had turned the program into something special.
sentences.zh: 在1987年接手该职位后的一年内，乔就把这个项目办得有声有色。

sentences.en: His trainees revered him.
sentences.zh: 他的学员们对极为崇敬他。

sentences.en: If you were in Joe's squad, you were considered a badass.
sentences.zh: 如果你在乔的队伍里，你就会被认为是个狠角色。

sentences.en: Joe had recently been tasked with completing an inventory of all the Explorers' assets.
sentences.zh: 乔最近的任务是完成对所有探险者资产的清点。

sentences.en: He headed to the post to get an early start, making a quick stop at a gas station at around
sentences.zh: 他前往驻地早早开始工作，大约在早上7点05分在一家加油站快速停留。

sentences.en: Despite being fit and strong, Joe was also a heavy smoker, and he always kept two packs of cigarettes tucked in his car's sun visor.
sentences.zh: 尽管乔身体健壮，但他也烟瘾很大，他总是在汽车的遮阳板里塞着两包香烟。

sentences.en: He stocked up his supply and resumed his journey.
sentences.zh: 他补充了香烟，然后继续上路。

sentences.en: But as Joe made his way to the post, he took a detour past Honing Road, a rural stretch approximately one and a half miles from the community centre.
sentences.zh: 但当乔前往驻地时，他绕道经过了霍宁路，这是一段距离社区中心约一英里半的乡村道路。

sentences.en: At 7.52am, he picked up his police radio and contacted dispatch to report some suspicious activity.
sentences.zh: 早上7点52分，他拿起警用电台联系调度中心，报告了一些可疑活动。

sentences.en: Joe told the operator,
sentences.zh: 乔告诉接线员：

sentences.en: I'm going to be out at the old concrete plant checking on two males, whites, one male black.
sentences.zh: 我将去老水泥厂查看两名白人男子和一名黑人男子。

sentences.en: Although Joe wasn't technically yet on duty, there had been recent reports of vandalism in the area, and he had agreed to keep an eye on things.
sentences.zh: 尽管乔严格来说还没有开始值班，但该地区最近有破坏公物的报告，他答应帮忙留意情况。

sentences.en: Besides, he was the kind of officer who considered himself on duty any time he was in town.
sentences.zh: 此外，他是那种只要在镇上就认为自己随时在执勤的警察。

sentences.en: The dispatcher asked Joe if he needed backup.
sentences.zh: 调度员问乔是否需要支援。

sentences.en: Joe responded,
sentences.zh: 乔回答说：

sentences.en: Negative at this time.
sentences.zh: 目前不需要。

sentences.en: Three minutes later, at 7.55am, Joe radioed in again.
sentences.zh: 三分钟后，即早上7点55分，乔再次通过电台呼叫。

sentences.en: He told the dispatcher the men had taken off towards the swamp and he was pursuing them on foot.
sentences.zh: 他告诉调度员，那些人已经逃向了沼泽，他正在步行追赶他们。

sentences.en: He gave his location as the gravel road that ran between the cement plant and Honing Road.
sentences.zh: 他报出的位置是水泥厂和霍宁路之间的砂石路。

sentences.en: Although he sounded cool and calm, the dispatcher once again asked if he wanted backup.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的声音听起来冷静镇定，但调度员再次询问他是否需要支援。

sentences.en: This time, Joe responded,
sentences.zh: 这一次，乔回答：

sentences.en: Go ahead and send somebody.
sentences.zh: 去派个人来吧。

sentences.en: Three police cars were quickly dispatched to the area, arriving on Honing Road at 8.01am.
sentences.zh: 三辆警车迅速被派往该地区，于早上8点01分抵达霍宁路。

sentences.en: Lieutenant Joe Glinowicz's squad car was parked near the old cement factory, but Joe himself was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 乔·格利诺维茨中尉的警车停在老水泥厂附近，但乔本人却不见踪影。

sentences.en: The backup officers headed into the surrounding woods and battled their way through the marshy bog and thick scrub.
sentences.zh: 增援警员进入周围的树林，艰难地穿过泥泞的沼泽和茂密的灌木丛。

sentences.en: The scrub was dense with green vegetation, making it near impossible to see through.
sentences.zh: 灌木丛中长满了绿色的植物，几乎让人无法看透。

sentences.en: The dispatcher radioed Joe, asking for his current status.
sentences.zh: 调度员用电台呼叫乔，询问他的当前状况。

sentences.en: There was no response.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: They radioed for a second time.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了第二次电台呼叫。

sentences.en: Still nothing.
sentences.zh: 依然毫无音讯。

sentences.en: The dispatcher asked the other officers,
sentences.zh: 调度员问其他警员：

sentences.en: Fox Lake units on Honing, check status on 6740.
sentences.zh: 在霍宁路的福克斯湖分队，检查6740的状况。

sentences.en: One officer responded,
sentences.zh: 一名警员回答：

sentences.en: We don't have him right now, we're looking for him.
sentences.zh: 我们现在找不到他，我们正在找他。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a loud bang rang through the air.
sentences.zh: 突然，一声巨响划破空气。

sentences.en: There was no mistaking the sound.
sentences.zh: 那个声音绝对不会听错。

sentences.en: It was a gunshot.
sentences.zh: 那是枪声。

sentences.en: The officers charged further into the woods towards the swamp, trying to follow the direction of the noise.
sentences.zh: 警员们朝着沼泽方向冲进树林深处，试图顺着声音的方向追踪。

sentences.en: The dispatcher continually tried to radio Joe, but to no avail.
sentences.zh: 调度员不断试图用电台呼叫乔，但都无济于事。

sentences.en: Calls were placed to Joe's cell phone, but those too went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 拨打乔的手机也同样无人接听。

sentences.en: The minutes ticked by as the officers battled onwards.
sentences.zh: 随着警员们艰难前行，时间一分一秒地流逝。

sentences.en: Then, at 8.09, one officer pushed their way through the scrub and came to the bank of the swamp.
sentences.zh: 然后，在8点09分，一名警员拨开灌木丛，来到了沼泽岸边。

sentences.en: A little further into the woods, lying face down, was the body of Joe Glinowicz.
sentences.zh: 再往树林里走一点，趴在地上的是乔·格利诺维茨的尸体。

sentences.en: The officer rolled him over.
sentences.zh: 警员把他翻了过来。

sentences.en: Blood was coming from his nose and seeping out from above his collar.
sentences.zh: 鲜血正从他的鼻子流出，并从他的衣领上方渗出来。

sentences.en: The officer radioed the dispatcher, announcing,
sentences.zh: 警员通过电台向调度员报告：

sentences.en: Officer down.
sentences.zh: 有警员倒下。

sentences.en: It was a devastating sight for the first responding officers.
sentences.zh: 这对第一批赶到的警员来说是个惨痛的景象。

sentences.en: One in particular became overwhelmed with emotion, touching Joe's hand and wailing,
sentences.zh: 其中一人情绪彻底崩溃，触摸着乔的手痛哭道：

sentences.en: Why Joe?
sentences.zh: 为什么是乔？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Joe?
sentences.zh: 乔？

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: Another said,
sentences.zh: 另一个人说：

sentences.en: He's gone.
sentences.zh: 他走了。

sentences.en: Get your gun out and call out anything you see.
sentences.zh: 拔出你的枪，看到什么大声喊出来。

sentences.en: Joe Glinowicz had been shot twice.
sentences.zh: 乔·格利诺维茨胸中两枪。

sentences.en: The first bullet struck him in the right hip, where he kept his mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 第一颗子弹击中了她的右髋部，他把手机放在那里。

sentences.en: Joe was wearing a ballistic vest, which prevented the bullet from entering his body.
sentences.zh: 乔穿着防弹衣，这阻止了子弹进入他的身体。

sentences.en: But his luck stopped there.
sentences.zh: 但他的好运也就到此为止了。

sentences.en: The second bullet had been shot downwards into Joe's vest, striking him in the chest and penetrating his pulmonary artery.
sentences.zh: 第二颗子弹向下射入乔的防弹衣，击中他的胸部并穿透了他的肺动脉。

sentences.en: Such an injury meant he would have bled to death within minutes.
sentences.zh: 这样的伤势意味着他会在几分钟内因失血过多而死。

sentences.en: Evidence at the scene indicated a struggle had taken place.
sentences.zh: 现场的证据表明发生过搏斗。

sentences.en: Scattered around the ground were several of Joe's belongings, including his pepper spray with its safety tab removed.
sentences.zh: 地面上散落着乔的几件物品，包括拔掉安全栓的胡椒喷雾。

sentences.en: A little further away lay Joe's baton and glasses.
sentences.zh: 稍远处躺着乔的警棍和眼镜。

sentences.en: Two shell casings were also recovered a short distance apart.
sentences.zh: 在相距不远的地方还找到了两个弹壳。

sentences.en: This meant the gunshots had been fired from two different locations within the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 这意味着枪击是从犯罪现场的两个不同地点发射的。

sentences.en: The shell casings matched the .40 calibre service pistol carried by Joe Glinowicz.
sentences.zh: 弹壳与乔·格利诺维茨佩戴的.40口径配枪相匹配。

sentences.en: However, his holster was empty and the pistol itself was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的枪套是空的，配枪本身却不见踪影。

sentences.en: This raised the harrowing probability that the men Joe had been pursuing were now on the run with his stolen gun.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一种令人揪心的可能性：乔一直在追捕的男子现在正带着他偷来的枪在逃。

sentences.en: A police bulletin immediately went out, warning that the trio were armed and dangerous.
sentences.zh: 警方立即发布了通告，警告三人持有武器且极度危险。

sentences.en: 400 heavily armed officers from across Illinois sped towards Fox Lake, a small village of less than 11,000 residents.
sentences.zh: 来自伊利诺伊州各地的400名重武装警员迅速赶往福克斯湖，这是一个居民不到11000人的小村庄。

sentences.en: They sealed off the two-square-mile radius surrounding the crime scene, focusing the hunt for the shooters within.
sentences.zh: 他们封锁了犯罪现场周围方圆两英里的区域，将搜捕枪手的重点放在其中。

sentences.en: It wasn't an easy place to search.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个容易搜查的地方。

sentences.en: The designated kill zone consisted of heavily wooded areas, waterways, homes and businesses.
sentences.zh: 指定的作战区由密林、水道、住宅和企业组成。

sentences.en: It was also a hot day and the swampy landscape had generated harsh humidity.
sentences.zh: 这也是个热天，沼泽地带产生了严酷的湿气。

sentences.en: Officers wearing heavy tactical gear and carrying rifles began passing out from the heat.
sentences.zh: 身穿沉重战术装备并携带步枪的警员开始因炎热而晕倒。

sentences.en: But investigators were taking no chances.
sentences.zh: 但调查人员没有抱任何侥幸心理。

sentences.en: Joe Glinowicz was the first officer to be fatally shot in the line of duty in Lake County since 1980 and the first ever to be killed in Fox Lake.
sentences.zh: 乔·格利诺维茨是自1980年以来莱克县第一位在执勤中殉职的警员，也是福克斯湖有史以来第一位被杀的警员。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the Labor Day long weekend was just four days away, a holiday that attracted thousands of tourists to the area.
sentences.zh: 此外，劳动节小长假仅仅四天之遥，这个节日吸引了数千名游客来到该地区。

sentences.en: Apprehending those responsible was of the highest priority.
sentences.zh: 抓捕肇事者是当务之急。

sentences.en: A SWAT team and 45 K-9 units were brought in, while five helicopters and a fixed-wing aeroplane surged overhead.
sentences.zh: 特警队和45只警犬被调入，同时五架直升机和一架固定翼飞机在头顶盘旋。

sentences.en: Some businesses were closed while schools were put on lockdown.
sentences.zh: 一些企业关门，学校被封锁。

sentences.en: The local trains were stopped and residents were urged to stay indoors.
sentences.zh: 当地火车停运，并敦促居民呆在室内。

sentences.en: One sniffer dog successfully picked up a scent.
sentences.zh: 一只搜救犬成功嗅出了气味。

sentences.en: It was followed until the scent was lost with no discoveries.
sentences.zh: 一直追踪到气味消失且无任何发现。

sentences.en: Word of what happened spread quickly in the close-knit community.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情的消息在这个紧密的社区中迅速传开。

sentences.en: Lieutenant Joe Glinowicz was somewhat of a local celebrity, known for his trademark outfit consisting of fatigues, combat boots and military hat.
sentences.zh: 乔·格利诺维茨中尉在当地算是个名人，以其标志性的服装而闻名，包括迷彩服、作战靴和军帽。

sentences.en: Combined with his tattooed, muscly arms and tough persona, he'd earned the nickname of G.I.
sentences.zh: 再加上他那有纹身的肌肉手臂和硬汉形象，他赢得了“G.I.”的绰号。

sentences.en: Joe.
sentences.zh: 乔。

sentences.en: Residents were shocked to learn that G.I.
sentences.zh: 居民们得知G.I.时感到震惊。

sentences.en: Joe, of all people, had been gunned down.
sentences.zh: 乔偏偏是遭到枪击的人。

sentences.en: But none were as shocked as Melody Klinowicz, Joe's wife of 26 years.
sentences.zh: 但没有人比乔结婚26年的妻子梅洛迪·克利诺维茨更震惊了。

sentences.en: When she was delivered to the news by Mayor Donnie Schmidt,
sentences.zh: 当多尼·施密特市长将这一消息告诉她时，

sentences.en: Melody collapsed and became physically ill.
sentences.zh: 梅洛迪瘫倒在地，身体感到不适。

sentences.en: Mayor Schmidt told CNN,
sentences.zh: 施密特市长告诉CNN：

sentences.en: The whale that went out of her mouth, then, will stay with me forever.
sentences.zh: 她当时发出的悲鸣，将永远留在我的记忆中。

sentences.en: However, the manhunt for Joe's killers intensified.
sentences.zh: 然而，对乔的凶手的搜捕行动加剧了。

sentences.en: All investigators had to go by was the vague description Joe had given the dispatcher, two white men and one black.
sentences.zh: 所有调查人员只能根据乔提供给调度员的模糊描述，两个白人和一个黑人。

sentences.en: This made it near impossible to narrow down the suspect pool.
sentences.zh: 这使得缩小嫌疑人范围变得几乎不可能。

sentences.en: One call came through from a concerned citizen who reported they'd seen the three suspects loitering near the treatment plant.
sentences.zh: 一位热心市民打来电话，报告说他们看到三名嫌疑人在处理厂附近闲逛。

sentences.en: Another became suspicious when they saw an unknown man running into a vehicle.
sentences.zh: 另一个人看到一个陌生男子跑进一辆车里时起了疑心。

sentences.en: Other calls came through, with locals eager to help in any way they could, but nothing emerged that identified the shooters.
sentences.zh: 其他电话也打了进来，当地人急于以任何可能的方式提供帮助，但没有出现能够识别枪手的信息。

sentences.en: With no arrests made by nightfall, helicopters fitted with thermal cameras flew overhead.
sentences.zh: 由于夜幕降临仍未抓获嫌疑人，配备热成像仪的直升机在头顶飞过。

sentences.en: Police obtained dashcam footage from a truck driver who was in the area around the time of the shooting,
sentences.zh: 警方获取了一名在枪击案发生时在该地区的卡车司机的行车记录仪画面，

sentences.en: as well as recordings from traffic cameras and security footage from a local homeowner.
sentences.zh: 以及交通摄像头的录像和当地房主的监控录像。

sentences.en: The footage was examined, but no immediate leads emerged.
sentences.zh: 对录像进行了检查，但没有出现直接线索。

sentences.en: The search resumed at first light on Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 搜查在周三早晨的第一缕曙光中重新开始。

sentences.en: Schools in the district remained closed as a safety precaution, but with the thermal scanners failing to detect anything,
sentences.zh: 作为安全预防措施，该地区的学校仍然关闭，但由于热扫描仪未能探测到任何东西，

sentences.en: it was deemed unlikely that the killers were still in the area.
sentences.zh: 人们认为凶手还在该地区的可能性不大。

sentences.en: The search expanded beyond the two-mile kill zone, with investigators turning their focus to tip-offs while they waited for forensic analysis of the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 搜查范围扩大到了两英里作战区之外，调查人员将重点转向了线索，同时等待犯罪现场的法医分析。

sentences.en: The commander of Lake County's Major Crimes Task Force, George Falenko, fronted a press conference appealing for help from the public to catch the shooters, whom he described as
sentences.zh: 莱克县重案特别行动队指挥官乔治·法连科在新闻发布会上呼吁公众协助抓捕枪手，他将枪手描述为

sentences.en: He urged residents to remain vigilant, saying,
sentences.zh: 他敦促居民保持警惕，并说：

sentences.en: All it takes is one tip or one good lead to break a case wide open.

sentences.en: When Anne Marron was told about the recovered text messages, she was astonished.
sentences.zh: 当安妮·马龙听到恢复的短信内容时，她震惊了。

sentences.zh: 她与乔的对话一直都很愉快，她没有任何理由认为他们之间有什么宿怨。

sentences.en: Investigators could find no further evidence to suggest that Joe had seriously considered hiring a hitman to remove Marron from the equation.

sentences.en: It was possible his comments were just distasteful attempts at dark humour.

sentences.en: Regardless,
sentences.zh: 无论如何，

sentences.zh: 作为一名警局中尉，

sentences.zh: 然而，他社交媒体账号上发布的照片表明，他的生活方式比他的薪水所能支持的要奢华得多，不仅去夏威夷度假，还频繁在

sentences.zh: 几天后，惊慌失措的乔给他的儿子DJ发短信，提及一笔总计超过2,000美元的身份不明的支出。

sentences.en: You are borrowing from that other account,
sentences.zh: 你在挪用另一个账户的钱，

sentences.en: The next day, he texted DJ again, saying,
sentences.zh: 第二天，他又给DJ发短信说：

sentences.en: I'm sticking my neck out there.
sentences.zh: 我正在冒着极大的风险。

sentences.en: He mentioned thousands of dollars he'd lent DJ to fix his truck and pay for a summer vacation.
sentences.zh: 他提到了他借给DJ用于修理卡车和支付暑假费用的数千美元。

sentences.en: According to Joe, this meant there wasn't enough money left in the Explorer's account to pay for upcoming expenses.
sentences.zh: 据乔所说，这意味着“探路者”账户里剩下的钱不够支付即将到来的开支了。

sentences.en: He needed DJ to pay the money back so that if anyone asked, he could explain that Explorer participants were given loans from time to time.
sentences.zh: 他需要DJ把钱还回来，这样如果有人问起，他就可以解释说“探路者”项目的参与者会不定期获得贷款。

sentences.en: Joe wrote,

sentences.en: Looking through them,
sentences.zh: 翻看这些纸箱时，

sentences.zh: 马龙惊奇地发现里面装满了官方军事装备，包括防毒面具、防弹背心、作战靴、枪带以及关于特警战术

sentences.en: But that wasn't all.
sentences.zh: 但不仅如此。

sentences.en: his own personal expenses.
sentences.zh: 他自己的个人开销。

sentences.zh: 乔用这个账户支付了从房贷、健身房会员费到在线色情内容的各项费用。

sentences.zh: 随着所有这些新证据浮出水面，调查人员对此深信不疑。

sentences.zh: 他可能认为自己有两个选择：要么因挪用慈善资金而暴露，要么以英雄的身份死去。
